name: Turkish delight (lokum)
about: A soft, chewy sweet dusted with powdered sugar, long made in Istanbul. Hacı Bekir is one of the city's oldest shops for it.
tip: Check the pistachio content and the weight on the box before you pay.

name: İznik ceramic
about: Hand-painted tilework and pottery with classic Turkish patterns. İznik was a major ceramic center, and its style is closely tied to Istanbul's mosques and palaces.
tip: Hand-made pieces cost much more than machine-made ones, so ask how each piece was made.

name: Turkish towel
about: A lightweight cotton towel woven in Turkey, known for being quick to dry. Turkish towels are a classic Istanbul bath and hammam item.
tip: Check the label for synthetic blends, since mixed-fiber towels feel and dry differently.
